title: v0.35.0
summary: Decision models Ollama now supports decision models through /v1/systemone , based on TypeSafe’s Jev API . Decision models return choices, probabilities, and scores instead of text. Use them for tasks such as ticket triage, model routing, and content classification. Available models: Nimble from Bespoke Labs Tev1 from Together AI ollama pull nimble Send context and one or more questions: curl http://localhost:11434/v1
summaryZh: Ollama v0.35.0版本正式引入决策模型（Decision Models）支持，基于Jev API实现。该功能允许模型返回选择、概率和分数而非纯文本，适用于工单分类、模型路由等场景，显著提升了Ollama在结构化任务处理中的实用性。
